name: AnimatedList-TS-TW
blurb: Scrollable list with scale/opacity animations and keyboard navigation support.
description: Interactive list with InView-triggered animations, arrow key navigation, optional gradient overlays, and selection callbacks. Uses Framer Motion for animations.
use_when: Displaying selectable list items with smooth entry animations and keyboard accessibility.
avoid_when: Very large lists where animation overhead could impact performance.
a11y: Supports arrow keys, Tab, Shift+Tab for navigation and Enter to select. Selection state visible through background color change.
